name: Why Go To Church
overview: Scripture reveals that gathering in the presence of God is both a divine ordinance and a heartfelt desire of the believer. From God's rest on the seventh day (Genesis 2:2) and the command to keep the Sabbath holy (Exodus 20:8), we see the importance of setting apart time for worship. The Psalms express a deep longing to dwell in the house of the Lord (Psalms 27:4) and affirm the blessing of unity among believers (Psalms 133:1). Moreover, the joy and value of being in God's courts surpass all worldly pleasures (Psalms 84:10), emphasizing why believers are called to assemble regularly in church.
